purpose: My dissertation looks at whether asthma goes together with higher body weight.
question: What is the mean BMI of patients with asthma by region?
definitions: Asthma = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J45.
Use the latest BMI (LOINC 39156-5) per patient; patients without a BMI are left out.
Report per region: number of patients with a BMI and mean BMI, one decimal.
